sentences.text:
Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Moksha Khajuria Kazmi, Judge
 Order

This is a petition for initiation of contempt proceedings against the respondents for their willful disobedience and non-compliance of order dated 16th of March, 2023 passed by this Court in WP (C) No. 214/2022, whereby the respondents had been directed to initiate the process of land acquisition in accordance with law.

2. On 09.12.2024, it was brought to our notice by the Department of Public Works (R&B) that the requisite amount demanded by the Collector Land Acquisition had been placed at the later's disposal and it was now for the Collector Land Acquisition to initiate the proceedings in accordance with law.
3.

Today, a status report on behalf of the Collector Land Acquisition has been handed over to us in the open Court, a perusal whereof, indicates that the process of acquisition, as was directed by this Court, has been initiated by the Assistant Commissioner, Revenue, Rajouri by issuing a Notification under Section 11 (1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and the acquisition proceedings are now required to be conducted by the Collector within the time frame mentioned in the Act.
